rules.text: If the percentage inscriptions positioned above each browser's bar are the dashboard's authoritative current market_share values and each inscription is attached to the bar beneath it, then the browser with the greatest printed percentage is the browser to select under the stated highest-current-market_share queue rule.
rules.conditions: This bridge applies only if the printed percentages, rather than bar heights, encode current market_share and are correctly attached to their respective browser bars.

rules.text: If the vertical bar heights share the displayed y-axis scale, larger upward bar extent encodes larger current market_share, and the browser label beneath each bar identifies that bar, then the tallest browser bar is the browser to select under the stated highest-current-market_share queue rule.
rules.conditions: This bridge applies only if the unlabeled vertical scale represents current market_share and the bar geometry is authoritative despite conflicting percentage inscriptions.
